newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,654 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 2,654 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 2,654 contracts compared with 2,135 overnight Thursday.
There were 185 wheat, 615 corn, 1,449 soybean, 228 soymeal, 84 soyoil, 19 oat, 17 corn puts, 40 soybean calls and 17 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 3-1/2 to nine cents higher, corn was 1/2 to two cents higher and soybeans were one cent higher to 4-3/4 cents lower.
